# Issue #3: Emit Project Model v0 from primary tasks before planning or architecture work

## Purpose

Implement the Build Arena side of Project Model v0.

Build Arena's role is to turn a primary task/backlog item into a mechanically checkable Project Model before planning, architecture selection, or code work begins.

Parent coordination issue: https://github.com/leonbreukelman/build-arena/issues/2

## Agent role

You are the Build Arena implementation agent.

Your job is to emit the Project Model. Do not implement Elenchus evaluation logic here, and do not build the arena-calibration fixture harness here.

## Agent instructions

1. Read the parent Project Model v0 contract first.
2. Inspect the existing deterministic decomposer path, especially the README's Phase 5 notes and any `arena.decomposer` implementation.
3. Update or implement the decomposer so a primary task/backlog item can produce a Project Model v0 document.
4. Keep the implementation deterministic and local-first. Do not require live paid LLM/API calls for tests.
5. Add validation for the Project Model quality gate:
   - every component has a responsibility;
   - every component has at least one observable/measurable check;
   - dependencies are explicit and non-contradictory;
   - invariants are represented separately from ordinary goals;
   - verification gaps are surfaced rather than hidden;
   - unclassified project surfaces are reported.
6. Preserve the distinction between ownership accounting and quality scoring. Build Arena may say "this surface is covered/missing"; Elenchus/arena-calibration decide whether a proposal's rationale aligns.
7. Add or update CLI/API behavior so callers can request Project Model v0 in canonical JSON.

## Expected output shape

The emitted model should include, at minimum:

- `schemaVersion`
- `sourceTask`
- `goal`
- `nonGoals`
- `components`
- `dependencies`
- `invariants`
- `observableChecks`
- `evidenceRequirements`
- `assumptions`
- `risks`
- `nearNeighbors`
- `heldOutProbes`
- `verificationGaps`
- `unclassifiedProjectSurface`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A primary task can be converted into Project Model v0 JSON.
- [ ] The JSON validates against the parent contract.
- [ ] `--fail-on-gap` or equivalent behavior fails/flags missing checks, missing components, and unclassified project surface.
- [ ] At least one non-code task example is covered, not only code-patch examples.
- [ ] Tests prove the decomposer catches a shallow/vague decomposition as a quality-gate failure.
- [ ] Existing deterministic behavior and current green gates are preserved.
- [ ] README/docs explain how `elenchus-core` and `arena-calibration` should consume the emitted model.

## Non-goals

- Do not score proposal truth or optimality.
- Do not add live-provider dependency for acceptance.
- Do not implement the Elenchus advisory signal protocol beyond producing the model it consumes.
- Do not treat F3 as only a code-patch/generalization problem.

invariants.description: Every included source/config/test/doc file is owned exactly once or the model is invalid.
Project Model emission and validation must not require live paid LLM/API calls.

nearNeighborAlternatives.description: Start implementation or architecture work from the backlog item without a shared Project Model.
nearNeighborAlternatives.whyNotPrimary: That reopens the F3 risk of coherent work aimed at the wrong component, sequence, or example.

nearNeighborAlternatives.description: Use file ownership coverage as the only decomposition signal.
nearNeighborAlternatives.whyNotPrimary: Ownership accounting does not express responsibilities, dependencies, non-code checks, risks, or held-out probes.

nonGoals: Do not require live paid LLM/API calls to emit or validate this model.
Do not implement Elenchus scoring or advisory evaluation in the Build Arena decomposer.
Do not treat ownership accounting as quality scoring.

observableChecks.description: Inspect surfaced verification gap(s) for Documentation And Operator Guidance.
observableChecks.observableSignal: verification gap is present in verificationGaps and has proposed closure evidence

observableChecks.description: Project configuration is exercised by normal tests/tooling.

evidenceRequired: terminal output for `uv run python -m compileall .`

observableChecks.description: Verify in-repo calibration fixture patches and expected labels are present and exercised by scorer/verifier calibration tests.
evidenceRequired: terminal output for `uv run pytest tests/test_calibration_ordering.py tests/test_scorer_determinism.py tests/test_verifier_calibration.py -q`
observableChecks.observableSignal: fixture paths resolve and relevant calibration/scorer/verifier tests pass without live API calls

observableChecks.description: Verify runtime/tooling config and scorer lock boundaries remain explicit and reproducible.
evidenceRequired: terminal output for `uv run pytest tests/test_scorer_lock.py tests/test_budget.py -q`
operator confirmation for intentional .arena/scorer.lock.toml updates when scorer sources change
observableChecks.observableSignal: scorer lock tests and normal repo tooling run against the checked-in configuration files

observableChecks.description: Verify schema-generated artifacts are reproducible and covered by schema generation tests.
evidenceRequired: terminal output for `uv run pytest tests/test_schema_generation.py -q`
git diff showing generated artifacts are unchanged after regeneration, or an intentional generated update
observableChecks.observableSignal: `make generated` and schema generation tests keep generated contracts in sync with schema/arena.yaml

observableChecks.description: Verify dashboard placeholder/generated surfaces are classified without implementing the deferred dashboard control plane.
evidenceRequired: run report statement that dashboard control plane remains out of scope
observableChecks.observableSignal: dashboard placeholder/generated files are named as deferred/generated surfaces and no dashboard control-plane behavior is claimed by this issue

risks.description: A downstream agent could start coherent work against the wrong component, sequence, or visible example if the Project Model is skipped.
risks.mitigation: Emit Project Model v0 before planning and consume its components, dependencies, checks, and gaps.

risks.description: documentation files exist but no mechanical doc/spec drift check is derivable from the filesystem scan
risks.mitigation: add a project-specific doc/spec drift checker or explicit acceptance fixture

risks.description: Calibration fixtures could be treated as ordinary implementation files instead of evidence fixtures.
risks.mitigation: Keep calibration fixture data under a fixture component with artifact-audit evidence and scorer/verifier regression tests.

risks.description: Generated schema/dashboard artifacts could drift from schema/arena.yaml or be hand-edited.
risks.mitigation: Use make generated plus schema-generation tests and diff inspection as the observable check.
